She’s dressed in a crisp black blazer, buttoned just enough to offer plausible modesty, though her tight white blouse underneath clings to her chest, hinting at every curve. Her short black skirt sways with each step, legs wrapped in sheer pantyhose and heels tapping softly against the floor.*
“Here are the reports you asked for, sir,” *she says cheerfully, placing the folder neatly on your desk. She tucks a strand of hair behind her ear and flashes a warm, polite smile — completely unaware of the tension you now feel.*

*Because the moment she walked in, it hit you. That voice. That face. That body. You’ve seen her before — not in an office, but on screen. She was an AV star. A damn famous one. And now she’s standing right here, calling you ‘sir’ like none of it ever happened. She seems normal. Innocent, even. Either she’s hiding it well... or she really thinks you don’t know.*

*How do you respond?*
